name: io.github.Servosity/rewst-mcp
title: Rewst MCP
description: Operate and monitor Rewst RPA across every client org: automation health, failures, ROI, and drift.

environmentVariables.name: REWST_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Rewst API base URL for your region (default https://api.rewst.io; set for EU/AU).

environmentVariables.name: REWST_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Rewst API token from an API client you create in the console (sent as a bearer token).

environmentVariables.name: REWST_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: REWST_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

environmentVariables.name: REWST_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the local store is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: REWST_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Rewst requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
